## The problem

What are you trying to build, and where does the module get in the way?

## What you would like

The API you would want to write. A prop, a slot, an event, an attribute field.

```vue
<NvCalendar :new-prop="value" />
```

## What you do today

The workaround you are using, if any. This helps judge how much the feature
would actually save.

## Alternatives

Other shapes the feature could take, and why you prefer yours.
